cohort: The cohort consisted of 200 antenatal women with one or more high-risk factors such as IUGR, PIH, GDM, BOH, PREV.LSCS, or PROM.
finding: Modified biophysical profile (MBPP) showed an increased positive predictive value for perinatal outcome compared to individual NST and AFI, indicating it is a reliable diagnostic test to predict a positive outcome.
